en-US.shortDescription: Ask what's on your SAT, ACT, AP or diploma exam. Answers come from the official syllabus, with the objective code.
en-US.fullDescription: Syllabuddy answers the question every student asks: is this even on my exam? It checks the official syllabus (2,883 learning objectives: the digital SAT and PSAT, the ACT, 24 AP courses, the Alberta Diploma Physics 30 and Chemistry 30, and the Singapore-Cambridge A-Level) and tells you whether a topic is examinable, explicitly excluded, or not covered, quoting the syllabus wording and objective code. Tell it which exams you're taking and when, and it checks every question against those syllabuses, quizzes you out loud, remembers which objectives you keep getting wrong, and counts down to exam day, so 'what should I revise first?' has a real answer.
examplePhrases: Ask Syllabuddy if the ratio test is on the AP Calculus AB exam
I'm taking AP Calc BC and the SAT, my exam is May 11
